#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# AI-Assisted: Initial draft generated by Claude Code; reviewed and modified by author.

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect

async def test_game_log_functionality():
    """测试游戏日志功能"""
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()

        await page.goto('file:///workspace/index.html')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        # 获取初始日志容器
        log_container = await page.query_selector('#logContainer')
        initial_entries = await log_container.query_selector_all('.log-entry')
        assert len(initial_entries) == 0, "初始日志应该为空"

        # 掷骰子
        dice_btn = await page.query_selector('#diceBtn')
        await dice_btn.click()

        # 等待动画完成
        await asyncio.sleep(1)

        # 检查日志是否记录了掷骰子事件
        log_entries = await log_container.query_selector_all('.log-entry')
        assert len(log_entries) > 0, "应该有日志记录"

        first_log = await log_entries[0].text_content()
        assert '掷出' in first_log, "日志应该包含掷骰子信息"

        await browser.close()
        print("✓ 游戏日志功能测试通过")


async def test_reset_button():
    """测试重新开始按钮"""
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()

        await page.goto('file:///workspace/index.html')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        # 掷骰子
        dice_btn = await page.query_selector('#diceBtn')
        await dice_btn.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)

        # 检查日志不为空
        log_container = await page.query_selector('#logContainer')
        log_entries_before = await log_container.query_selector_all('.log-entry')
        assert len(log_entries_before) > 0, "应该有日志记录"

        # 点击重新开始按钮
        reset_btn = await page.query_selector('#resetBtn')
        await reset_btn.click()

        # 等待重置完成
        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        # 检查日志是否被清空
        log_entries_after = await log_container.query_selector_all('.log-entry')
        assert len(log_entries_after) == 0, "重置后日志应该被清空"

        # 检查骰子数字是否重置
        dice_number = await page.query_selector('#diceNumber')
        dice_text = await dice_number.text_content()
        assert dice_text == '0', "骰子数字应该重置为0"

        await browser.close()
        print("✓ 重新开始按钮测试通过")


async def test_victory_detection():
    """测试胜利判定"""
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()

        await page.goto('file:///workspace/index.html')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        # 获取胜利弹窗元素
        victory_modal = await page.query_selector('#victoryModal')

        # 检查初始状态下弹窗不显示
        modal_classes = await victory_modal.get_attribute('class')
        assert 'show' not in modal_classes, "初始状态下胜利弹窗不应该显示"

        # 手动设置一个玩家的所有飞机都完成
        await page.evaluate('''() => {
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                gameState.planes[0][i].flying = true;
                gameState.planes[0][i].finished = true;
            }
            checkVictory();
        }''')

        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        # 检查胜利弹窗是否显示
        modal_classes = await victory_modal.get_attribute('class')
        assert 'show' in modal_classes, "当玩家完成所有飞机后，胜利弹窗应该显示"

        # 检查胜利标题
        victory_title = await page.query_selector('#victoryTitle')
        title_text = await victory_title.text_content()
        assert '获胜' in title_text, "胜利标题应该包含获胜信息"

        await browser.close()
        print("✓ 胜利判定测试通过")


async def main():
    print("开始运行功能测试...\n")
    try:
        await test_game_log_functionality()
        await test_reset_button()
        await test_victory_detection()
        print("\n✓ 所有测试通过！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n✗ 测试失败: {e}")
        raise


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
